easyPrerequisites: You control five or more creatures.
description:
Activate Boss's Chauffeur by paying {1}{U}, blinking it. Boss's Chauffeur enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
When Boss's Chauffeur enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Boss's Chauffeur.
Activate Boss's Chauffeur using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
